description: Acquire finite count-rate observations for AND logical channels formed from two or more input channels.

deviceId.description: TimeTagger device that creates the logical channels and acquires their count-rate measurements.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Exact lease union: only the TimeTagger when latchGuard is disabled, or that TimeTagger plus every network-resolved detector-health guard when it is required.

items.description: One device needed by this finite acquisition.

observations.description: Unique AND-logical coincidence observations acquired together in one finite window.

observationId.description: Caller-stable identifier used as the output-map key.

inputRefs.description: At least two physical TimeTagger channel references joined by AND.

logicalOperator.description: Logical operation used to form the channel.

coincidenceWindowPs.description: Coincidence window applied by the AND logical channel, in picoseconds.

durationSec.description: Finite integration duration of the shared coincidence observation window, in seconds.

clear.description: Whether every selected coincidence measurement is cleared before the window.

latchGuard.description: Explicit finite-window detector-latch policy; disabled permits an unguarded observation, while required validates network-declared detector-health guards and retries only the invalid window.

mode.description: Whether detector-latch validation is disabled or required for this observation.

maxWindowRetries.description: Maximum immediate retries after a recovered detector latch; use zero to reject the first invalid window.

acquisition.coincidence.observation.wind.description: Verified context and raw device response for the completed shared acquisition window.

acquisition.coincidence.plan.definitions.description: Resolved stable logical-channel and measurement definitions indexed by observation identifier.

acquisition.coincidence.observation.obse.description: Normalized coincidence observations indexed by observation identifier.

acquisition.coincidence.observation.coun.description: Total coincidence counts indexed by observation identifier.
Coincidence rates in hertz indexed by observation identifier.

acquisition.coincidence.status.latchGuar.description: Explicit latch-guard policy, health samples, accepted-window attempt, discarded-window count, and any terminal guard failure.
